method: Actual TypeScript callbacks evaluated in an isolated VM; browser storage and timer mocked, no network or Firebase calls.

findings.trigger: In an unrecorded payroll period, enter 0.5 in Performance Bonus / Overtime, then click Record Payroll Simulation.
findings.impact: Payroll accepts an input that fails its declared step=100000 constraint. Saved/onscreen money retains fractions while the generated PDF rounds them, so the archive and PDF disagree.

findings.trigger: Edit sample payment method: valid last four digits and billing email, Expiry Date=99/99, Cardholder / Entity Name=three spaces, then Save Payment Method.
findings.impact: Malformed expiry and blank cardholder labels pass native required checks and are persisted. This affects local simulation labels only, not a live payment processor.

findings.trigger: If stored payroll history has invalid JSON, opening HR runs the lenient loader and unconditional persistence effect.
findings.actual: The loader falls back to fixture payroll records, and the mount effect overwrites the original payroll history with those fixtures.
findings.impact: Damaged payroll data cannot be recovered from browser storage after opening HR. Existing recorded/payroll status is silently replaced instead of showing a recoverable storage error.
findings.limitation: Requires already-corrupt localStorage; no normal UI input path to corrupt JSON was established.

disproved: Finance search pagination already resets page to 1 onSearchChange.
